predicate.name: Access expansion
predicate.description: Whether evidence accessible under one evaluator condition remains accessible under another.

predicate.name: Admissible observational indistinguishability
predicate.description: Whether two admissible worlds are observationally indistinguishable under the selected observation model.

predicate.name: Structural Assurability equivalence
predicate.description: Whether two systems have equal Structural Assurability profiles in the selected comparative context.

predicate.name: Structural Assurability incomparability
predicate.description: Whether neither system is at least as assurable as the other in the selected context.

predicate.name: Assurance-relevant structural dimension
predicate.description: Whether a candidate structural dimension admits a separating construction producing non-equivalent Structural Assurability profiles.

predicate.name: At least as assurable
predicate.description: Whether one system preserves all Structural Assurability capabilities available from another in the selected context.

predicate.name: Capability monotonicity
predicate.description: Whether enlarging an evidence set preserves capabilities enabled for the selected claim.

predicate.name: Claim disagreement
predicate.description: Whether a claim has different truth values in two worlds.

predicate.name: Claim resolved by observation
predicate.description: Whether observationally indistinguishable admissible worlds necessarily agree on the claim.

predicate.name: Evidence-capability equivalence
predicate.description: Whether two evidence sets enable the same capability set for the selected claim.

predicate.name: Evidence-capability preorder
predicate.description: Whether the capability set enabled by one evidence set is contained in that enabled by another for the selected claim.

predicate.name: Observational indistinguishability
predicate.description: Whether two worlds produce the same observation under the selected observation model.

predicate.name: Evidentiary sufficiency
predicate.description: Whether an evidence set satisfies the selected sufficiency standard for a claim.

predicate.name: Resource expansion
predicate.description: Whether evidence feasible under one resource budget remains feasible under another.

predicate.name: Strictly more assurable
predicate.description: Whether one system is at least as assurable as another while the reverse comparison does not hold.
